about: lane stress16b (2026-10-16): the model-only Saddler stress disc (STRESS_SADDLER, NOT THE GAME). Stand-in room 119 (the village at night, after El Gigante) holds Saddler's final form (em31, r332 on GC Disc 2): PS2 body + head (ps2_cast.py saddler-em31-00) and tentacle (saddler-em31-01), with two gameplay levels each (glod_rung.py --pct 70 / 50 --shift 2, boss spec hard_cap_mm 80; same atlases), drawn by the warp line's level (NATIVE_MODEL_REGISTRY_LOD + STRESS_SADDLER). Package: model_registry.py --stress-saddler (1 MiB, 256 part facts).
lighting: em31: the constant registry colour (no source-light bit for em31)
